source_record_subset.pg: SELECT "t2"."admemail1" , "t2"."admemail2" FROM "frpm" AS "t1" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "t2" ON "t1"."cdscode" = "t2"."cdscode" WHERE "t2"."county" = 'San Bernardino' AND "t2"."city" = 'San Bernardino' AND "t2"."doc" :: integer = 54 AND EXTRACT( YEAR FROM "t2"."opendate" ) BETWEEN 2009 AND 2010 AND "t2"."soc" :: integer = 62
